# Caddy — servlet-mapping-push-url

servlet-mapping with PUSH relocated to /VAADIN/push. The push URL resolves against the context, which here is the root, so the site already carries it and the config is the same file as servlet-mapping.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/ui/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Caddy site block (`caddy/templates/servlet-mapping.caddyfile`), mounted as
`/etc/caddy/vaadin.caddyfile`:

```caddyfile
# App at /, with the Vaadin servlet bound to /ui/* instead of the root.
#
# Hilla does not follow vaadin.url-mapping: /HILLA/* (its push endpoint) and
# /connect/* (browser-callables) stay at the context root whatever the Vaadin
# servlet is mapped to, while the browser asks for them under /ui. So those two
# paths lose /ui on the way in. See vaadin/hilla#289.
#
# Everything else reaches the backend untouched: /ui/* for the Vaadin servlet
# (including /ui/VAADIN/push), and the root-level resources that stay at the
# root whatever the mapping is — /VAADIN/*, /sw.js, /styles.css,
# /manifest.webmanifest, /icons/*, /images/*, /test-redirect.
:80 {
	import common

	@hilla path /ui/HILLA/* /ui/connect/*
	uri @hilla strip_prefix /ui

	reverse_proxy vaadin:8080
}
```

The global options and the `common` snippet this file imports (the
access log and the compression allowlist) come from the shared
[Caddyfile](../../Caddyfile), mounted read-only over the image's own
`/etc/caddy/Caddyfile`. It imports this file, so the two only load as a pair.
